sections.title: The Look and Feel of High-Performance
sections.body: The Kenya AI Compute brand identity is designed to reflect our core values: technological precision, industrial stability, and the vibrant energy of the East African tech scene. Our visual language uses a primary palette of Deep Tech Blue and Cyber Cyan, balanced with the earth tones of our Kenyan roots. We provide these assets to our partners, media outlets, and contractors to ensure that every representation of our project meets our global standards for quality. Please follow our Brand Guidelines (available for download) regarding clear space, minimum size, and proper color usage to ensure the integrity of our visual identity is maintained in your communications. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence.
